Cards Total | 154 |- ! Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy''' is the 28th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 10 January 2001. It is 154 cards (77 per side): 34 very rare foils, 62 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 54 premium cards, plus five foil box/case toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below, two unique premiums (listed under Card list), and random reprints. Those reprints are not listed. Some packs did not contain a Japanese card. A foil of a title that is not on this list (and is not one of the box/case toppers) is not a Decipher Reflections II pack foil.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections III''' is the 31st Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 31 October 2001. It has 200 cards (100 per side): 100 foils and 100 non-foil premiums. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus three unique premiums (listed under Card list)[https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists], Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) and random reprints from Premiere through Endor. Those reprints are not listed. A foil of a title that is not on this list is not a Decipher Reflections III pack foil (it may be a [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]] or a counterfeit).[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2].
